title: Mailgun Review for Agent Builders: Inbound Parsing, Retention and Pricing (2026)
summary: A Mailgun review for developers whose AI agent must receive and answer email: how Routes deliver replies, what store() keeps, retries, plans and the MCP server.
body_markdown:
Developer Resources · August 21, 2026


### [AgentMail vs Mailgun](https://www.agentmail.to/blog/agentmail-vs-mailgun)


Mailgun is a transactional email API with a catch-all route and short-window MIME retention. AgentMail is built around the inbox as the primitive for AI agents, with framework connectors, prompt-injection defenses, and BYOC deployment. Here is what each one is built for, the agent loop in code, and how the routing, retention, threading, security, and pricing compare.
